description:
[p0dcasters] Full-text search over the titles, descriptions, authors and domains of every podcast listed, on any host (own domain, hosting platform or network library). Returns shows, each with its slug, feed URL, page and playlist. Only shows with an episode inside the last 90 days are listed.
